correctness.rationale: PASS: For T=H+iK, r=||H|| and s=||K||, the centrally symmetrized numerical-range hull C has support h_C(theta)=||H cos(theta)+K sin(theta)||. Reflection across real axis and the Minkowski average D=(C+conj C)/2 satisfy mean h_D^2<=mean h_C^2 by Jensen. D has both axis radii r,s and contains E=conv{+-r,+-is}; hence the exact integral of max(r²cos²,s²sin²) bounds Q_2(T)² below. Quadrant integration gives r²/2+[rs+(s²-r²)atan(s/r)]/pi for r>0, and s²/2 for r=0. Equality in the two nonnegative continuous support differences forces C=D=E. Diagonal operator diag(r,-r,is,-is) realizes all norm pairs; Taylor expansion gives 4s³/(3pi r)+O(s^5/r^3) for fixed r>0. Independent quadrature checked endpoint, symmetry and cubic asymptotics; universal proof is analytic, not numeric.
